abstract.p: The present disclosure relates generally to compounds of formula (I) that bind to and act as degraders of an IKAROS Family Zink Finger (IKZF) protein, such as IKZF2 (Helios) and/or IKZF4 (Eos). The disclosure further relates to the use of said compounds for the preparation of a medicament for the treatment of diseases and/or conditions through binding and degradation of an IKZF protein, such as IKZF2 and/or IKZF4, including cancer.
